query.insertStudente: INSERT INTO studenti(email, password, nome, cognome, nascita, cid) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?);
query.insertDocente: INSERT INTO docenti(email, password, nome, cognome) VALUES(?,?,?,?);
query.checkAmministratore: SELECT aid FROM amministratori WHERE email = ? and password = ?;
query.checkStudente: SELECT sid FROM studenti WHERE email = ? and password = ?;
query.checkDocente: SELECT did FROM docenti WHERE email = ? and password = ?;
query.getStudenti: select * from studenti order by cognome, nome;
query.getStudentiByClasse: select * from studenti where cid = ? order by cognome, nome;
query.getDocenti: select * from docenti order by cognome, nome;
query.getClassiByDocente: select c.* from classi as c join materie as m on c.cid = m.cid and m.did = ? order by anno, sezione;
query.getMateriaByClasseDocente: select materia from materie where cid = ? and did = ? order by materia;
query.getClassi: select * from classi order by anno, sezione;
query.getMaterieClasse: select m.materia from classi c join materie m on m.cid = c.cid where c.cid = ? order by materia;
query.insertVoto: insert into voti(voto, materia, data, did, sid) values(?,?,?,?,?);
query.getVotiByStudenteMateria: select * from voti where sid = ? and materia = ? order by data desc;
query.deleteVoto: delete from voti where vid = ? limit 1;
query.getVotiByStudente: select * from voti where sid = ? order by data desc;
query.insertMateriaDocente: insert into materie(cid, did, materia) values(?,?,?)
